column1: # comment: Universal-event alignments (#41) — gmeow:Event + the gmeow:Participation relator + the open gmeow:eventType / gmeow:ParticipantRole / gmeow:TemporalPrecision value vocabularies, supersetting schema.org Event, CIDOC-CRM E5/E7, OWL-Time, PROV-O, iCalendar, LODE, SEM, BIO / GEDCOM X (the life-event types) and Wikidata BY REFERENCE. VALUE VOCABULARIES: eventType / participationRole individuals are gufo:QualityValue values, aligned to external classes, fact-types and role-properties with skos:closeMatch (a value-to-class/property correspondence), mirroring placeType. An unforeseen type/role is a fresh individual, never a new class or subproperty (Principle 9 — no overtyping, no role-subproperty proliferation). REIFIED PARTICIPATION: gmeow:Participation is the NameUsage relator idiom; it carries role / period / confidence / provenance / standpoint that schema.org's flat attendee/performer/organizer and OWL-Time's participation-free interval algebra cannot. The flat gmeow:hasParticipant covers the 80% case and projects to the flat targets. CONTESTED FACTS: a disputed type, role, date or location is several coexisting gmeow:accordingTo-indexed claims (standpoint module, #43), never one slot to win; there is no preferredRank / primaryClaim. CANONICAL (no faithful external term): gmeow:temporalPrecision, gmeow:earliestStart / latestEnd fuzzy bounds (related only to CRM E52 P82a/P82b begin/end-of bounds), and gmeow:EventSeries recurrence (projected to iCalendar RRULE, not aligned here).
